finding: Cleanup ran before installation but was never scheduled on ordinary startup. Returning users could retain interrupted retirement indefinitely unless they installed another model. Empty cleanup also initialized unnecessary directories.

contract.invocation: One background invocation per page after successful saved-model activation or a successful open with no active installation. Cache/activation errors suppress automatic cleanup. Chat readiness and chooser presentation do not await the invocation.
contract.bounds: At most 16 bounded store passes under one 60000ms cancellation signal. These are policy bounds, not measured real-model performance budgets.
contract.mutation: Do not race durable cleanup against the lifetime's rejection promise. Signal cancellation stops cancellable reads/lock waits and further work; an issued mutation retains its lock until storage settles. Diagnostics report stopping while pending and incomplete after timeout settlement.
contract.observability: Advanced cache_cleanup diagnostics report status, typed error, pass count and removal counts from completed passes only. Partial failed-pass removals are excluded; these counters do not measure storage recovered. Cleanup failure does not classify the active cache as corrupt.
contract.empty: cleanup no longer initializes directories. Actual Edge confirms physically empty startup creates no model root. openActive remains read-only.
contract.unchanged: Existing current six-member admission/qualification, retirement ownership, active-pointer reconciliation, visual markup and runtime artifact bytes.
